summary: The Homer Public Library in Alaska relies heavily on E-Rate funding to cover 70% of its library internet costs. The comment argues that eliminating or reducing E-Rate funding could have severe consequences for library access and patron affordability.

claims.argument: Eliminating E-Rate could lead to unaffordable costs for libraries
claims.evidence_quote: If eliminated or reduced, this could severely affect access to the internet as well as push unaffordable costs onto the patrons of the library.
